jobs.name: Groundwater, transport and UI with pinned real MF6, MF2005 and NWT

steps.name: Set the explicit real-engine path before test discovery
Install optional groundwater and UI dependencies
Prepare and verify exact public MF6 and classic double-precision engines
Check all tests with actual MF6 and refuse every skip
Export and verify a portable groundwater model
Save, relocate and rerun the spatial project roundtrip example
Load, rewrite and execute both classic groundwater engines
Execute authored geoscience file and geometry examples
Fit authored conductivity and storage using actual MF6 and reject flat data
Retain real-engine evidence even when a check fails
